name: Temple Fishing
tooltip:
Temple Fishing
Instant
Recommended Skill: 300

Sitting atop The Coiled Isle is a place few anglers are willing to cast their line. Coalesced venom imbues the creatures lurking below. These oddities are grotesque and vile.

Pools found in this zone:
- Viscous Venom
- Vile Venom
- Vile Oddities
